dispatch.start_event: G0接受一次backend_start后只启动layer33 scheduler
dispatch.layer33_to_layer34: layer33完成不生成operator_result_valid；确认layer33完成后才启动layer34
dispatch.terminal_event: layer34成功或任一算子失败产生无backpressure内部终态；正常全网pilot恰有一个终态事件
dispatch.global_deadline: 唯一G0 whole-task timeout；层切换不重启计数，无child-local timeout
dispatch.shared_memory_master: 冻结T12单outstanding master；仅active child可驱动G0 shell memory request/response

layer34.legacy_single_input_scale_semantics: manifest generic sequential-predecessor field; route input_scales/order are authoritative

golden.generator: 连续xorshift32固定seed；每步state%255-127；先NCHW layer32后NCHW layer23
golden.layer34_oracle: manifest refs顺序[33,23]；T19冻结Q31 multiplier、整数half-away rounding、signed INT8饱和[-127,127]

layer33.comparison: 逐 byte 对完整 86,528-byte NCHW nearest-repeat tensor 比较

layer34.comparison: 逐 byte 对完整 259,584-byte NCHW route/concat tensor 比较

memory_responder.implementation: direct-index TB responder, not T10 instance
memory_responder.t10_source_binding_role: 冻结T10 SHA用于逐项对照；仿真不实例化T10 sparse patch model
memory_responder.sequence_state: 每类 stall index 从0开始；仅 accepted transaction 后加一；hard reset、soft reset和cancel不清零
semantics_asserted: single active byte lane for each read or write; read/write strobes mutually exclusive
single outstanding T12 transaction; responder accepts only the held current request
address and data/strobes/fault fields remain stable for every stalled request cycle
read data and error code are presented with accepted ready/valid response
reads restricted to layer32, layer33, and layer23 frozen input ranges
writes restricted to sequential layer33 and layer34 output ranges; input writes rejected
unknown or uninitialized layer33 source bytes rejected
layer32/layer33/layer23 activation reads map to T10 READ_FEATURE class 2
layer33/layer34 output writes map to T10 WRITE_FEATURE class 3
no READ_INPUT class 0 or READ_WEIGHTS class 1 request is accepted
delay=0 is ready-high before the first accepting rising edge
delay=N>0 counts exactly N ready-low rising edges before acceptance
every accepted request asserts its class and observed low-ready edge count against T10 schedule
per-class stall index advances only on acceptance and persists through cancel and reset
hard reset, accepted soft reset, G0 abort/timeout cancel pending request before side effect

control_and_memory.ps_visible_abi: 原样实例化G0 s2a_runtime_shell；不修改CSR、register、memory或timeout语义
control_and_memory.serial_backend: 一次G0 backend_start；layer33与layer34各成功start握手一次；只layer34正常完成产生terminal event
control_and_memory.busy_start: full仿真在layer34 active期间写G0 CMD.start并确认busy状态未重复启动
control_and_memory.error_and_abort: G0 global timeout与memory error分别停止下游child；hard/soft reset及abort无迟到读写副作用
